newsitem.title: USA: Appeal of Cigna case set for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Appeal of Cigna case set for Wednesday.

text.p: The Pennsylvania Commonwealth Court is scheduled to hear arguments Wednesday in Harrisburg, Pa., on an appeal of a decision last year allowing CIGNA Corp to restructure.
The hearing is closed to the public and a decision by the full seven-judge court is not expected for several months, the court said.
The court also will consider whether the opponents of CIGNA's restructuring have any standing to bring an appeal in the case.
CIGNA's restructuring, which split the company's property-casualty business into two units, was approved by the Pennsylvania insurance commissioner in early February.
Under the restructuring, CIGNA created one unit for the profitable, ongoing property-casualty business and a run-off unit for the unprofitable, discontinued business.

American International Group Inc, Chubb Corp, St. Paul Cos Inc and several policyholders strongly opposed CIGNA's plan, citing, among other things, concern that the runoff unit might be insufficiently capitalized to pay future claims.
CIGNA said business was continuing as usual amid the court challenge.
"As far as we're concerned, it's business as usual," a CIGNA spokesman said.
CIGNA shares rose one to 139 in light trading in early afternoon on Tuesday.
